title: Opposing Influences of YouTube Influencers: Purchase and Usage Effects in the Video Game Industry
authors: Nan Li; Avery M. Haviv; Mitchell J. Lovett
eligible_reason: Main estimates (Table 3) regress daily log unit sales and log usage of Steam games on the continuous number of YouTube videos (current and binned lags) with AR(3) errors, game, weeks-since-release and genre-date FE, price and update/feature controls, estimated by a custom GMM/optimization routine with optional instruments (Run_Opt_Estimate). Continuous treatment, time-varying controls and nonlinear-in-parameters estimation; Adpocalypse is a single common shock. No binary staggered DiD.
design_notes: codes/main.R -> estimation_fun.R Run_Opt_Estimate(dep.var='log.units'/'log.usage', control.vars=c('update.combined','featured'), fe.vars=c('decay.week','genre.date'), ar.periods=3, bin.periods=list(1:7,8:14)). robustness.R (Tables 4-5) and analysis_full_interaction.R (Table 6) vary samples, instrument price, and interact video counts with characteristics.
data_files_note: README: random subset of 247 games (20% of games in the final analysis).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; screened from README, code and OpenAlex abstract ('Leveraging a natural experiment, Adpocalypse...').
